name: Nadi
floor_height_note: Assumed 0.3 m where data has none. Rough check: 2017 census mix is 39% concrete, 34% corrugated iron, 24% wooden; Fiji guidelines call for at least 600 mm under raised timber floors, while concrete and iron homes usually sit near the ground (assumed ~0.2 m). The weighted average is about 0.3 m. Replace with surveyed floor heights where available.
